system_prompt: You check one thing in a conversation between a user and an AI coding agent. You answer with one JSON object and nothing else.
question: question-definition.md
answer_format: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"score": an integer from 1 to 10, "cue": "the exact words of the newest user message that carry the correction, or an empty string"}. 1 means it is plainly not a correction, 10 that it plainly is, and 5 or 6 that it could be read either way.
